news.title: Should the UK capital’s higher ed institutions be ‘Londonmaxxing’?
news.summary_en: The Mayor of London has teamed up with London's institutions to make the case that the city is the higher education capital of the world. But what more can the city do to strengthen its case?
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: From exam leaks to a national movement: Inside the protests reshaping India’s education debate
news.summary_en: What began as outrage over the alleged NEET paper leak has evolved into a nationwide student protest movement. Reporting from Mumbai, The PIE explores why students say the crisis has become about far more than one examination or one minister.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Sunway University awards honorary master’s degree to Malaysian popstar Siti Nurhaliza
news.summary_en: Malaysian pop sensation Siti Nurhaliza has been awarded an honourary master's degree in Creative Arts and Media by Sunway University, with the songstress encouraging graduates to challenge themselves and "give back" to the country.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: UK unis join forces to offer study pathways for visa brake students
news.summary_en: Nine UK universities are working alongside the NGO Mosaik Education to provide remote postgraduate study opportunities to international students from countries subject to a strict study visa pause.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Seoul crowned world’s best student city for second year
news.summary_en: Seoul has been named the world’s best student city for the second consecutive year, while Tokyo retains second place and London takes third in the QS Best Student Cities 2027 index.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Nearly half of Canadian study visa refusals deemed “preventable”
news.summary_en: A new dashboard analysing Canadian study permit refusals has found financial documentation to be by far the most prominent reason for students being denied.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: English universities face “unstable hybrid” future, warns HEPI report
news.summary_en: English higher education is heading towards an “unstable hybrid” future as financial pressures intensify faster than expected, according to a new report from the Higher Education Policy Institute (HEPI).
news.author: Kim Martin
